p.CODKIT-IS-STANDALONE: Codkit is a standalone product for maintaining a structured patch set over any fork of an upstream its project type describes (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-016#TYPE-TERM`).

facts.TOOL-ROOT: The Codkit installation contains only tool code, specifications, documentation, and tests.
facts.FORK-DIR: The managed fork tree is an external upstream checkout selected by the operator.
facts.PATCHES-DIR: The patch-set directory is external and owns the pin, intervention artifacts, inventory, history, and runtime state.
facts.NO-LAYOUT-INFERENCE: No location is inferred from the current directory or from a neighbouring path.
facts.ROOTS-ARE-DISJOINT: `toolRoot`, `patchesDir`, and `forkDir` must be pairwise disjoint: no two may be equal and none may contain another. Resolution canonicalizes existing path prefixes before enforcing this invariant.

p.PATH-PRECEDENCE: For both external directories the precedence is command-line flag, environment variable, then `~/.codkit/settings.json`.

facts.FORK-PATH-SOURCES: The fork path sources are `--fork-dir`, `CODKIT_FORK_DIR`, and `forkDir`.
facts.PATCHES-PATH-SOURCES: The patch-set path sources are `--patches-dir`, `CODKIT_PATCHES_DIR`, and `patchesDir`.
facts.SETTINGS-SCHEMA: The user settings file is `~/.codkit/settings.json` with strict schema `{"codkitSettings":1,"patchesDir":"/absolute/path","forkDir":"/absolute/path"}`; either path may be omitted, but unknown fields, relative paths, and unsupported schema versions are errors.

facts.AI-NATIVE-APPLIES-TO-CODKIT: The AI-native TypeScript discipline applies to Codkit production code and tests.
facts.DEPENDENCIES-PERMISSIVE: Dependencies are permissive-only unless the owner explicitly approves an exception.
facts.LICENSE-PROPRIETARY: Tombstone (campaign STANDARDS, 2026-09-06): the proprietary posture of 2026-08-31 was cancelled by an owner decision; the anchor in force is `LICENSE-UPL` below. The address is not deleted (NEVER-RENAME-OR-DELETE-A-CITED-ANCHOR).
facts.LICENSE-UPL: Codkit is released under The Universal Permissive License (UPL), Version 1.0 (SPDX `UPL-1.0`); the root `LICENSE.md` is the governing notice, the `license` field of `package.json` states the same, and the standards packages under `vibevm/vibepacks/` carry the same licence. Changing this posture is an owner decision made in one commit that updates every licence statement together.
